headline: Morgan Stanley Stock Climbs: What's Happening Today?
summary: Morgan Stanley (NYSE:MS) shares are climbing Tuesday as a cooler-than-expected inflation reading slashed the odds of a near-term Fed rate hike and strong quarterly results from Wall Street peers set a constructive tone heading into the bank's own earnings report tomorrow.
